title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: The epic saga of a desert planet and its valuable spice, featuring political intrigue and ecological themes.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: The novel that defined cyberpunk, featuring hackers, artificial intelligence, and virtual reality.

title: The Three-Body Problem
author: Liu Cixin
description: A groundbreaking Chinese sci-fi novel about humanity's first contact with an alien civilization.

title: Snow Crash
author: Neal Stephenson
description: A satirical cyberpunk novel featuring a futuristic America with a virtual reality metaverse.

title: Blade Runner 2049
author: Denis Villeneuve
description: A young blade runner's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former blade runner Rick Deckard.

title: Interstellar
author: Christopher Nolan
description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

title: The Matrix
author: The Wachowskis
description: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality.

title: Arrival
author: Denis Villeneuve
description: A linguist works with the military to communicate with alien lifeforms after twelve mysterious spacecraft appear around the world.

title: The Godfather
author: Mario Puzo
description: The epic crime novel about the Corleone crime family that inspired the legendary film trilogy.

title: Blood Meridian
author: Cormac McCarthy
description: An epic novel of the violence and depravity that attended America's westward expansion.

title: The Dark Knight
author: Christopher Nolan
description: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

title: Pulp Fiction
author: Quentin Tarantino
description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

title: The Pillars of the Earth
author: Ken Follett
description: A sprawling medieval epic centered around the construction of a cathedral in 12th-century England. I recommend this for its rich characters, intricate politics, and how it turns architecture into thrilling drama.

title: Wolf Hall
author: Hilary Mantel
description: A literary and psychological deep dive into the mind of Thomas Cromwell during Henry VIII's reign. Recommended for its masterful prose and fresh, humanized perspective on Tudor politics.

title: The Name of the Rose
author: Umberto Eco
description: A medieval murder mystery soaked in theology, philosophy, and dark academia vibes. Recommended if you enjoy Sherlock Holmes-style logic wrapped in gothic atmosphere.

title: All the Light We Cannot See
author: Anthony Doerr
description: Set in Nazi-occupied France, this Pulitzer Prize-winning novel follows a blind French girl and a German boy whose paths eventually cross. It’s a poetic, luminous read—perfect if you love lyrical writing and stories of resilience during war.

title: The Book Thief
author: Markus Zusak
description: Narrated by Death, this WWII story follows a young girl in Nazi Germany who finds solace in stealing books and sharing them. It’s haunting, beautiful, and imaginative—especially if you enjoy emotionally powerful storytelling.

title: The Shadow of the Wind
author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
description: A gothic mystery wrapped in a love letter to literature, set in post–civil war Barcelona. A boy’s discovery of a forgotten book leads to dark secrets and shadowy figures. Must-read if you're into mystery, books-about-books, and moody atmospheres.

title: The Nightingale
author: Kristin Hannah
description: A deeply moving story of two sisters in Nazi-occupied France, showing different forms of resistance and sacrifice. Recommended for fans of emotional historical drama with strong female leads—it will definitely tug at your heartstrings.

title: Gladiator
author: Ridley Scott
description: A betrayed Roman general rises as a gladiator to take revenge against the corrupt emperor. Visually stunning and emotionally charged, this film is a must-watch for epic storytelling and Russell Crowe’s unforgettable performance.

title: Troy
author: Wolfgang Petersen
description: A dramatic retelling of Homer’s Iliad, centered on the Trojan War and Achilles’ rage. Filled with action, mythology, and tragic heroism—great if you’re into ancient legends with blockbuster flair.

title: The Northman
author: Robert Eggers
description: A brutal Viking revenge saga inspired by the legend of Amleth. With surreal visuals and primal intensity, it's a hauntingly raw exploration of fate, masculinity, and Norse mythology.

title: Schindler’s List
author: Steven Spielberg
description: A powerful Holocaust film based on the real-life story of Oskar Schindler, who saved over a thousand Jews. It's deeply moving and essential viewing for its emotional depth and historical significance.

title: Blonde
author: Andrew Dominik
description: A fictionalized and controversial look into Marilyn Monroe’s inner life and trauma. While visually striking and emotionally heavy, it’s more of a psychological art piece than a traditional biopic.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: Baz Luhrmann
description: A dazzling, modernized take on Fitzgerald’s classic novel. With its stylish visuals and Leonardo DiCaprio’s iconic Gatsby, it captures the glitz, tragedy, and obsession of the Jazz Age.

title: Titanic
author: James Cameron
description: A sweeping romance set against the backdrop of the real-life Titanic disaster. Jack and Rose’s love story is timeless, and the film blends historical drama with emotional weight and groundbreaking visuals.

title: Jodhaa Akbar
author: Ashutosh Gowariker
description: An epic romance between Mughal emperor Akbar and Rajput princess Jodhaa. Lavish sets, beautiful music, and historical drama make this a visual feast with a rich cultural backdrop.

title: Snow Like Ashes
author: Sara Raasch
description: A kingdom locked in eternal winter, a hidden heir.

title: Wicked Saints
author: Emily A. Duncan
description: A gothic dark fantasy where gods walk among humans, and a girl hears their voices. Perfect if you're into morally gray characters, intense magic systems, and enemies-to-something-more vibes.

title: Winterwood
author: Shea Ernshaw
description: A spooky, atmospheric standalone with witches, winter forests, and a mysterious boy who should be dead. If you love witchy, wintry vibes and haunting secrets, this one’s for you.

title: Mortal Engines
author: Philip Reeve
description: A steampunk future where cities move and eat smaller towns. It’s fast-paced, creative, and loaded with thrilling world-building—a classic YA adventure with depth.

title: Timebound
author: Rysa Walker
description: A teen time-traveler must stop a timeline-shattering cult. Recommended for fans of historical science fiction and twisty time travel with a strong female lead.

title: An Ember in the Ashes
author: Sabaa Tahir
description: A brutal empire, a rebellious slave girl, and a soldier torn by duty. Think Gladiator meets Avatar: The Last Airbender—high-stakes, emotional, and impossible to put down.

title: The Firebird
author: Susanna Kearsley
description: A blend of historical fiction and magical realism, following a woman with psychic abilities as she uncovers a mystery across centuries. It’s graceful, romantic, and atmospheric.

title: The Crown’s Game
author: Evelyn Skye
description: A magical duel between two enchanters in imperial Russia—with only one allowed to live. Dramatic, lush, and full of forbidden feelings and fantasy flair.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe
author: Based on the novel by C.S. Lewis (1950)
description: Classic good-vs-evil tale where children stumble into a wintry fantasy world ruled by a cruel witch. Perfect if you want noble quests, epic battles, and magical creatures.

title: Doctor Strange
author: Marvel Comics characters by Steve Ditko & Stan Lee
description: Mind-bending visuals and a reality-warping plot about a surgeon turned sorcerer. A must-watch for fans of multiverse concepts, time loops, and mystical philosophy.

title: The Green Knight
author: Marvel Comics characters by Steve Ditko & Stan Lee
description: A haunting, surreal take on honor and legend, full of eerie landscapes and cryptic symbolism. Ideal if you enjoy slow-burn fantasy with rich, medieval atmosphere.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
author: Based on the book series by Cressida Cowell
description: A heartwarming tale of friendship between a misfit Viking and a misunderstood dragon. It’s visually stunning, emotionally sweet, and great for all ages.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: An epic quest through Middle-earth to destroy a dark lord’s ring of power. One of the greatest fantasy films ever—dense world-building, sweeping music, and unforgettable characters.

title: Stardust
author: Based on the 1999 novel by Neil Gaiman
description: A whimsical and romantic fantasy adventure that follows a young man who crosses into a magical realm to retrieve a fallen star—only to discover it's a woman with a mysterious past. Think fairy tale meets swashbuckling adventure with a dash of dark humor. Highly recommended if you love enchantment, wit, and a fairy-tale vibe for grown-ups.

title: Alice Through the Looking Glass
author: Inspired by Lewis Carroll's 1871 novel
description: A visually lavish, time-traveling sequel to Alice in Wonderland. More steampunk flair and character-driven fantasy—great if you enjoy quirky logic and imaginative world design.

title: Inception
author: Unknown
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
author: Unknown
description: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

title: Matrix
author: Unknown
description: The matrix tells about a computer hacker learning from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

title: Alien: Romulus
author: Unknown
description: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

title: Aftermath
author: Unknown
description: After waking up in the forest with no memory, a young woman is targeted my mysterious strangers with a motive that’s unclear

title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
author: Unknown
description: After waking up in the forest with no memory, a young woman is targeted my mysterious strangers with a motive that’s unclear

title: Jumanji
author: Unknown
description: follows four high school students who are transported into the game as adult avatars and must complete challenges to return to the real world

title: Life Of A Pie
author: Unknown
description: The story begins when Pi’s father decided to take his family and the animals in his zoo crossing into Canada. Unfortunately, the ship is engulfed by a huge storm. Finally, only Pie and Richard, a Bengal tiger, are in the ocean, Pi must find way to make friend and survive with this wild friend.

title: Twister
author: Unknown
description: As storm season intensifies, the paths of former storm chaser Kate Carter and reckless social-media superstar Tyler Owens collide when terrifying phenomena never seen before are unleashed. The pair and their competing teams find themselves squarely in the paths of multiple storm systems converging over central Oklahoma in the fight of their lives.

title: Sherlock Holmes
author: Unknown
description: legendary detective Sherlock Holmes and his crime-solving partner, Dr. Watson , solving crimes

title: The Exorcism of God
author: Unknown
description: An American priest working in Mexico is considered a saint by many local parishioners. However, due to a botched exorcism, he carries a secret that’s eating him alive until he gets an opportunity to face his demon one final time.
